text: Implemented complete measured block assembly, Parseval and canonical-dual reconstruction, truncated-SVD projected reconstruction, exact/projected/certified statuses, frame rank/spectrum/condition/projection diagnostics, basis and edge completeness gates, ill-conditioning rejection, and dense resource preflight before block reads. Independent Parseval, asymmetric reversal, rank-deficient, counterexample, conditioning, and preflight tests pass; package suite passes in two groups (709 plus 883 expectations).
